item.title: Why NHL players tape their sticks and how it improves puck control
item.summary: NHL players tape their sticks for reasons that go way beyond hockey tradition. The tape changes the feel of the blade on the puck, helps prevent ice buildup, protects equipment and gives players a customized grip. From Connor McDavid to other NHL stars, individual tape jobs can be a reflection of playing style, comfort, visual preference, and well-established pregame routines.
